generalCriterionList.description: Tenders  from Joint ventures are not acceptable.

Bidders shall not be under a declaration of ineligibility for
 corrupt and fraudulent practices issued by Government of Karnataka
Bidders shall ensure upload of relevant document certifying his/her status as Scheduled Caste/ Scheduled Tribe/other reserved category as prescribed in the tender document.

It shall be the responsibility of the Bidder to ensure credit of Tender Processing Fee and EMD into the respective receiving bank accounts of e-Procurement on or before the last date and time of bid submission.
EMD Payments through e-Payment mode shall be made as one single transaction and payments made in part are liable for rejection.
Department Registration Details
Total value of civl engineering works executed and payments received in the last five years (year-wise)
List of existing commitments and ongoing work
List of works for which tenders already submitted
Banker Details
Conditional tenders will not be accepted
Before Quoting the rates tenderer should read the bid document carefully
The Tender Processing Fee shall not be refundable
The Employer reserves the rights to Reject or accept any or all the tenders without assigning any reasons
Bidders should abide to all the Terms and Conditions attached
Ensure that all required documents are uploaded in accordance with the tender document
Bidder should be Pay Difference amount in the name Chief Officer, TMC T Narasipura
The intending contractors are requested to note that they should abide by the detailed instructions and conditions contained in the Standard Tender documents KW-1
GST will be paid at the time of bill payment
The bidder should mention the UDIN No. on the turnover certificate, failing which bid is rejected
The work should be completed in 03 Months ( including monsoon)

To qualify for award of this contract, each Tenderer in its name should have in the last five years i.e. , 2021-22 ,2022-23, 2023-24 2024-25 & 2025-26 (a) achieved in at least Two financial years an average financial turn over in all cases of civil engineering construction works only
If the bidder uploaded the false document while participating in the tender, the bidder will be responsible and action will be initiated as per the tender clause
The Department is not responsible for any delay in accessing kppp portal.

The bidder shall submit a Site Inspection Certificate issued by the authorized Junior Engineer, Town Municipal Council , T. Narasipura. Failure to enclose the certificate shall render the bid liable for rejection.
Payment shall be made subject to the availability of T Narasipura Municipal Funds

tenderCriterionDocumentList.documentName: Annual turnover certificate issued by Chartered accountant with UDIN Number for past 5 years

KPWD Registration Certificate class-IV and above
Upload relevant documents as per tender document
